contexts.text: Hence it is called the heavenly Canaan.
The rivers going forth from Eden describe... the boundaries of the Land of Canaan...
By the Land of Canaan (the Angels) perceive nothing else but the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth...
Moreover the inhabitants of the Land of Canaan were for the most part of such a character as to make all worship consist in externals...
Under Ancient Church, see these references. AC 1238:2. AC 2913. AC 3686:2. Coro 41.
Here external worship without internal is Canaan ().

By the Land of Canaan is represented the Lord's Kingdom... Hence the Land of Canaan is called the Holy Land, also the heavenly Canaan; and as it represented the Lord's Kingdom, it also represented and signified the celestial and spiritual things which belong to His Kingdom; here, those which belong to the Lord Himself. AC 1585.

(Abram, etc.) went forth to go into the Land of Canaan () = that thus He proceeded to the celestial things of love. The Land of Canaan represents the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth; the reason of which is that the representative Church was instituted there... Hence it was called the Holy Land, although it was nothing less than holy, being inhabited by idolaters and profane people. This therefore is the reason why by the Land of Canaan here and in the following verses is signified the celestial things of love; for the celestial things of love alone exist in the Lord's Kingdom, and are what constitute His Kingdom. AC 1438. AC 1441.
The entrance of the Sons of Israel (into the Land of Canaan) represented the entrance of the faithful into the Lord's Kingdom. AC 2039:8. AC 4255:4. AC 5897:4. AC 6639:3.

The Land of Canaan was given them for a possession in order that they might represent the celestial and spiritual things of the Kingdom and Church of the Lord, and in order that a representative Church might be instituted among them, and because the Lord was to be born there. AC 3686:2.
Is not the whole Land before thee 1 () = all good. Land in a good sense, and here the Land of Canaan = what is celestial, thus good.

Hence all things which were in the Land of Canaan were representative; those in the middle of the Land represented the Lord's internal man, as Mount Zion and Jerusalem; the former celestial things, the latter spiritual ones; those somewhat remote therefrom represented those things which are somewhat remote from internal things; and those which were ultimate or at the boundaries represented the external man. AC 2973:2.
Under Boundary, see these references. AC 1866. AC 4116. AC 4270. AC 5196. AC 8539. AE 518:17.
Abram dwelt in the Land of Canaan () = the internal man, that he was in the celestial things of love.

All the Land which thou seest, to thee will I give it () = the Celestial Kingdom, that it is the Lord's... for by the Land of Canaan was represented the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens, or Heaven, and the Lord's Kingdom on earth, or the Church.

Arise, walk through the Land () = that He should survey the Celestial Kingdom... By the Land, or Land of Canaan, is signified the Kingdom of God in the Heavens, or Heaven, and the Kingdom of God on earth, or the Church.

The wars which were waged against the idolatrous inhabitants of the Land of Canaan all represented the combats of the Lord with Hell; and thence those of His Church and of the man of the Church. Illustrated.
All the nations which were in the Land of Canaan represented kinds of falsities and evils. Illustrated. AC 1857. AC 1868:2.
The Land of Canaan, in a holy sense, = the Lord's Kingdom, thus the Celestial of love, or good; principally the good with the Lord.
The last boundary of the Land of Canaan, or beyond Dan, is described by Damascus. Illustrated.
In order that representatives might cease, the (Jews) were cast out of the Land of Canaan.
Under Amorite, see this reference, and at AC 6306:4.

The Land of Canaan = the Lord's Kingdom; wherefore to thy seed will I give this Land () = that the heavenly Kingdom should be given for an inheritance to those who, from charity, have faith in Him. AC 2842:7. AC 3038. AC 6233.
These are the remains which are signified by the ten years in which Abram dwelt in the Land of Canaan ().
All the Land of Canaan () = the heavenly Kingdom. AC 3481:2.
The Land of Canaan = the heavenly Canaan, or Heaven. References.
That from the wilderness of Paran they explored the Land of Canaan () = that through the Lord's Divine Human there is the heavenly kingdom for the spiritual.

The extension of the celestial and spiritual things which are of doctrine is signified in the inward sense where the extension of the Land of Canaan is described by from Dan to Beersheba; for by the Land of Canaan is signified the Lord's Kingdom, also the Church, consequently the celestial and spiritual things which are of doctrine. AC 3693:5.

When a man becomes spiritual, or is being regenerated, the evils and falsities, or what is the same thing, the Genii and evil Spirits are expelled from this gate, or from this mind, and then goods and truths, or charity and faith, succeed in their place; which is signified by thy seed inheriting the gate of thine enemies ()... This was represented by the Sons of Israel expelling the nations from the Land of Canaan.
This is Hebron in the Land of Canaan () = the Church as to good. AC 2982.
Under Land, see these references. AC 3705. AC 4069. AC 4429.

As the Land of Canaan = Heaven, or the Lord's Kingdom, it is the Lord's Divine Human itself which is meant by the Land of Canaan in the supreme sense; for the Divine itself cannot inflow into Heaven except through the Lord's Divine Human. Signified. AC 3705. AC 4069.
(Restoration to Canaan, Explained.)
Thou shalt not take a woman from the daughters of Canaan () = that it should not be conjoined with affections of falsity and of evil... Canaan = what is false and evil. References. AC 3683.
Those Knowledges of external and corporeal truth which do not admit spiritual and celestial truth and good, are signified by the daughters of Canaan.
The daughters of Canaan, here () = affections of truth from what is not genuine; (because the daughters of Heth are understood).

From the most ancient people who dwelt in the Land of Canaan all the places there, according to their situation, distance, and boundaries, as to the quarters, became representative and significative. Illustrated. AC 4447:2.

By the Land of Canaan was represented and signified the Lord's Kingdom, thus the Church; thus all things of love and faith, for these belong to the Lord's Kingdom and the Church; and hence all things which were in the Land of Canaan were representative as to situation, distance, boundaries...
The inmost of the Land of Canaan was Hebron, and afterwards Beer-sheba...
The consummation of the second Church is described by the extirpation of the nations in the Land of Canaan...

To come to Isaac his father in the Land of Canaan () = to conjoin with the Divine good of the Rational, in order that His Human may become Divine. The Land of Canaan = the Lord's heavenly kingdom, and in the supreme sense, that is, when predicated of the Lord, His Divine Human.

Aram or Syria was separated by a river, namely the Euphrates, from the Land of Canaan, thus was outside the Land of Canaan, by which in the inward sense is signified the Lord's Kingdom, and in the supreme sense, the Lord's Divine Human. AC 4234:2. AC 4240. AC 4667.
The land of Gilead, where the mount was, was within the limits of the Land of Canaan understood in an extended sense...
To speak in the idiom of Canaan, or with the lip of Canaan = to apply one's self to what is Divine, Illustrated.; for by Canaan is signified the Lord's Kingdom, and in the supreme sense, the Lord.
Mount Seir was the boundary of the Land of Canaan on one side ().

Hence it is evident that every genuine or internal representative of the Church had departed from (the Israelites) before they came into the. Land of Canaan, where the outward representative of the Church was commenced among them in a full form; for the Land of Canaan was the very Land itself where the representatives of the Church could be presented; for all the places there and all the boundaries were representative from ancient times.
In the Land of Canaan () = in the Lord's Kingdom.
The sons of Jacob did not constitute any Church, but their descendants; and these not before they went forth from Egypt, and not actually until they came into the Land of Canaan.
Under Nation, see this reference.
The remains of the Most Ancient Church... were still in the Land of Canaan, especially among those who were called Hittites and Hivites... for there was the Garden of Eden.
Hence it is that the Land of Canaan, in the supreme sense = the Lord; in the relative sense, Heaven and also the. Church; and in the particular sense, the man of the Church. References.

As there is such merchandise, or goods and truths, in the Church and Kingdom of the Lord, the Land of Canaan, by which is signified the Church and Kingdom of the Lord, was so named from the most ancient time from merchandise or tradings; for in the Original Language, Canaan means this.
The Land of Canaan so called (in the time of the Most Ancient Church) was all the land from the river of Egypt to the river Euphrates ().

That land = the Church, is from this, that the Land of Canaan was the Land where the Church had been from the most ancient times, and afterwards where, with the descendants of Jacob, there was the representative of the Church. AC 5136, Enumerated, Explained. AC 5577. References. AC 6516:2. AC 7439:end. AC 8316. AC 8944:2.
Under Ascend, see this reference.

The Land which I have given to Abraham and Isaac, to thee will I give it () = Divine good appropriated... For the Land of Canaan, which is here meant by the Land, in the inward sense = the Lord's Kingdom, and thence the Church, which is the Lord's Kingdom on earth; and therefore it = good, for this is the very essential of the Lord's Kingdom and Church. But in the supreme sense, the Land of Canaan = the Lord's Divine good; for the good which is in the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens and on earth is from the Lord.
Under Hebrew Church, see this reference.
As by the Land of Canaan is signified the Lord's Kingdom and His Church, it is called a Land of mountains and valleys, at the rain of heaven drinking in the waters ().
What was beyond the boundaries of the Land of Canaan represented those things which are outside the Lord's Kingdom, which are falsity and evil.

The reason so many things have an opposite sense, is that before the Land of Canaan became the inheritance of the Sons of Jacob, it was possessed by nations by whom are signified falsities and evils; and also afterwards, when the Sons of Jacob went into what is contrary; for lands put on the representation of the nations and peoples in them, according to their quality.
In the representative sense, the Land of Canaan = the heavenly kingdom, consequently celestial and spiritual goods and truths, which exist inwardly with a man who is the Lord's Kingdom.

Because the famine was in the Land of Canaan () = desolation as to those things which are of the Church in the Natural... The Land of Canaan = the Church; and as it = the Church, it = the things of the Church. AC 5425. AC 5442. AC 5507. AC 6017. AC 6025:end. AC 6067. AC 6229. AC 6457. AC 6516. AC 6658.
As the Land of Canaan = the Lord's Kingdom in the Heavens... it is called a Land flowing with milk and honey. Explained. AE 619:7.

We have brought back (the silver) to thee from the Land of Canaan () = submission from what is religious... The Land of Canaan = what is religious. The Land of Canaan = various things, because it = that which includes so many things; for it = the Lord's Kingdom, and it = the Church, consequently also the man of the Church, for he is a Church; and as it = these things, it also = the Celestial which is of the Church, namely, the good of love, and also its Spiritual, which is the truth of faith, and so on; here, therefore what is religious belonging to the Church...

Go, come ye unto the Land of Canaan () = their habitation, namely, that of the truths of the Church in the Natural... The Land of Canaan = the habitation of those who have been of the Church; thus the habitation of the truths of the Church with good, because these things constitute the Church. AC 5965.
The famine was grievous in the Land of Canaan () = a want of such things in the Church. AC 6111. AC 6113. AC 6116.

The Amorites = evil, and also the Canaanites; and the other nations in that Land which are named in the Word = various kinds of evil and of falsity. Such things were represented by the nations when the Sons of Israel came into possession of the Land of Canaan; the reason was, that when the Sons of Israel represented the Church, these nations represented infernal things; and thus the Land of Canaan represented every state in the other life...
Under Bury, see this reference.

Hence also Abraham was commanded to go (to Canaan), and hence also the descendants of Jacob were introduced into it, and this not because that Land was more holy than others, but because from the most ancient times all the places there, the provinces, the cities, the mountains and rivers, were representative of such things as belong to the Lord's Kingdom, and the very names given to them involved such things; for every name which is given to any place or person from Heaven involves what is celestial and spiritual; and when it has been given from Heaven it is perceived there... AC 9340:2. DSS 102:end.
(Land here, meaning Canaan () = the Ancient Church, or the state of the Church in which the ancients were.)

The Church is indeed instituted with a man when he acts from the affection of good; but still it is not fully instituted until after he has fought against evils and falsities, thus until after he has undergone temptations; after this he becomes truly a Church, and is then introduced into Heaven, which is represented by the introduction of the Sons of Israel into the Land of Canaan.
To a Land good and broad () = Heaven, where are the good of charity and the truth of faith. Land, here the Land of Canaan = the Lord's Kingdom; thus Heaven.
To give them the Land of Canaan () = by which they would be elevated into Heaven.
Their elevation into Heaven is represented by the introduction (of the Israelites) into the Land of Canaan. AC 9305. AE 433:27.
1.2. Ye shall come to the Land which Jehovah will give you () = to Heaven which is with them from the Lord.
This state of Heaven was represented by the Land of Canaan being occupied by the nations, and by the Sons of Israel casting them out... AC 8294:end.
This was represented by the Sons of Israel not being at once introduced into the Land of Canaan...

All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away () = that it is the same with those who are of the Church, and that they have adulterated goods and falsified truths. The inhabitants of Canaan = those who are of the Church... The reason they signify those who have adulterated goods and falsified truths, is that the nations there who were driven out by the Sons of Israel, represented the evils and also the falsities of faith...

They ate manna until they came to the boundary of the Land of Canaan () = that they experienced the appropriation of good from truth until they came to the region of Heaven... The Land of Canaan = Heaven.

Before regeneration all good is acquired through truth, but after regeneration man is led by the Lord through good... The latter state is represented by the introduction of the Sons of Israel into the Land of Canaan...
The latter state (of the regenerate) is described by the state of the Sons of Israel in the Land of Canaan under Joshua.
Hence it was commanded that the nations in the Land of Canaan should be accursed... AC 9320:2.

Similar things to what were represented by these three feasts were represented by the leading forth of the Sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, by their introduction into the Land of Canaan, and by their dwelling there. Explained.
The Land of Canaan = the Church as to good, thus the good of the Church. References.
After the Land of Canaan had been divided among the Sons of Israel, that Land and the other lands which surrounded it had a similar signification to the camp and what was outside the camp...

After the Lord had come into the world, that nation could not be kept in such ignorance as they had been in before; therefore they were expelled from the Land of Canaan, lest they should defile and profane internal things by denial in that Land where from the most ancient times all the places had become representative of such things as are of Heaven and the Church.
To lead the people to the Land of Canaan () = to cause them to be the Church.

The reason the Israelitish nation were introduced by Jehovah into the Land of Canaan, is that the Church had been in the Land of Canaan from the most ancient times, and because the Word could not be written anywhere but there, thus among the nation which possessed that Land... because all the places in that universal Land, and around it, as the mountains, the valleys, the rivers, the woods, and all others, had become representative of celestial and spiritual things... NJHD 5. WH 12.
The science of correspondences was not only known, but also cultivated in many kingdoms of Asia, especially in the Land of Canaan, etc.
In the Word in Heaven... instead of the Land of Canaan, there is the Church itself.
Those ancient people with whom that Word is still in use in Heaven, were partly from the Land of Canaan and its confines... TCR 279.

That the noxious things on the Earth derive their origin from man, and thus from Hell, may be confirmed by the state of the Land of Canaan... for when the Sons of Israel lived according to the commandments, the earth gave forth her increase... and when they lived contrary to the precepts of the law, the ground was barren... it yielded thorns and briers... and wild beasts broke in.
The Messiah, Who as they suppose is to lead them back to the Land of Canaan... But by the Land of Canaan, into which it is said that they are to be introduced, is meant the Lord's Church. AE 433:27.
The consummation of the Ancient Church is described... especially by the casting out of the nations from the Land of Canaan by the Sons of Israel.
The Land of Canaan = the Church... The Spiritual of the Church is signified by the Land of Canaan and by the rivers in it.
(The significations of places in Canaan were from the ancient Word.)
(How the Jews explain the way in which they suppose that they will all come into the Land of Canaan.) SE 2878.
Their habitations were given them, as the lands of the nations were given to the Sons of Israel in Canaan.
The Land of Canaan = Heaven and the Church with its truths. AE 374:7. AE 403:11. AE 475:18. AE 638:14. AE 644:6. AE 654:12.
The lip of Canaan = the genuine truths of the Church. AE 391:13. AE 654:7.

The Land of Canaan represents and thence signifies in the Word the Church; the region of it beyond the Jordan, the external Church; and the region of it on this side Jordan, the internal Church. AE 440:7. AE 569:4.
Then fought the kings of Canaan () = the falsities of evil against which there is combat.
By the nations which were driven out of the Land of Canaan, were signified the evils to be cast out of the Lord's Kingdom. AE 650:60. AE 650:62.
By the last boundaries of the Land of Canaan, are signified the ultimates of the Church, which are knowledges containing the Knowledges of truth and good. Signified.

The ultimates of Heaven... were represented by the two seas and the two rivers which were the boundaries of the Land of Canaan; the two seas were the sea of Egypt and the sea of the Philistines where Tyre and Sidon were; and the two rivers were the Euphrates and the Jordan; but the Jordan was the boundary between the interior and the exterior Land of Canaan. AE 569:4.

All those things which were outside the Land of Canaan signified such things as are of the natural man, but those things which were within the Land of Canaan signified such things as are of the spiritual, thus which are of Heaven and the Church...

The Scientific... is signified by the Nile, and the Rational... by the Euphrates; to these two the spiritual Church extends itself which is signified by the Land of Canaan; in like manner the spiritual mind with the man of the Church.
The beginning of a New Church after the end of forty years is described by their introduction into the Land of Canaan.
That the extension of the Land of Canaan... was from the Nile to the Euphrates, Illustrated.
Under Assyria, see this reference.
The Land of Canaan, into which the Sons of Israel were at last introduced, represented the Church, which regarded in itself is spiritual. AE 700:12.
When the Land of Canaan was possessed by idolatrous nations, the signification of the places and cities in that Land was changed into the contrary.
(The signification of the various quarters, regions, and cities of Canaan explained in general.)

That after temptations man becomes spiritual, and is introduced into the Church, and through the Church into Heaven, was represented by the introduction of the Sons of Israel into the Land of Canaan, for the Land of Canaan signified the Church, and also Heaven.

The states of Heaven and of the earth being according to the states of the Church, was represented among the Sons of Israel by the face of the Land of Canaan... being changed according to the states of the Church with them. Described.
The consummation of the Church of the nations within the Jordan, or in the Land of Canaan, is described by the expulsion and slaughter of some of them.
The second state of this Church was instruction and at last intromission into the Land of Canaan...

After these instructions the Sons of Israel were intromitted into the Land of Canaan; for the Land of Canaan represented and thence signified the Church; for that Land was in the central part of the whole of our world, having Europe in front, Africa on the left hand, and Asia behind it and on the right hand.
